label: Gold (COMEX GC) - regime-first, backtest-hardened

accuracyCeilings.regime: Textbook safe-haven prior is unreliable (gold fell ~11% during an active Mideast war in June 2026 because oil->inflation->rates dominated). The regime gate overrides it.
accuracyCeilings.shortHorizon: No directional lean shorter than the next dominant catalyst (FOMC/CPI). Band + trigger only.
accuracyCeilings.structural: Central-bank bid and year-end bank targets floor quarters, not weeks - never cited as near-term support. A bank target CUT is a coincident bearish signal.
accuracyCeilings.realYield: The 10Y-TIPS inverse can be regime-broken; weight it only when rolling correlation confirms it is intact.

qualitativeProtocols: REGIME GATE: decide which channel drives gold now - oil->inflation->rates vs real-yield inverse vs USD/debasement. Escalation is not automatically gold-positive. (LLM/analyst judgement; the engine approximates via price/vol/COT/real-yield correlation only.)
Anchor FOMC/CPI reads to the primary release (Fed SEP, BLS/BEA), not secondary spin. (Out of deterministic scope - declared.)
Both-branch event framing for each scheduled catalyst (hawkish vs dovish -> price consequence).
